title: Blue Barn Cidery
specs: Outdoor seating with views and year-round patio
Guests must be 21+ to purchase alcohol with valid photo ID
Children under 21 allowed with adult supervision; disruptive children will be asked to leave
Pets allowed only in outdoor seating area; must be leashed, vaccinated, and well-behaved
Large groups welcome; please notify in advance for staffing
Private Party Tent available May through September for rent
includes: Tables, chairs, bistro lighting, view of West Wind Farm for party tent
blurb: Guests order food and drinks at the bar and choose their own seating indoors or outside. The cidery offers a variety of hard ciders, craft beers, cocktails, and local wines. Outdoor seating with views is available year-round, and the farm offers pick-your-own fruit July through October.
extraNote: No outside food or beverages allowed inside the Tasting Room · Seating is first-come, first-served; no reservations except Sunday brunch during Nov-May · Bus/limo groups must register 24 hours in advance; no guaranteed seating · Visibly intoxicated guests will be denied service and may be asked to leave · Tabs left open at close charged 20% gratuity; tip bartenders in cash when possible
